newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Centam leaders to hold summit before Clinton visit.
newsitem.headline: Centam leaders to hold summit before Clinton visit.

text.p: Central American presidents will gather in Costa Rica in early May prior to a planned visit to the region by U.S. President Bill Clinton, officials said on Friday.

Nicaraguan President Arnoldo Aleman plans to join his counterparts from Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Costa Rica, Belize and Panama in San Jose, Costa Rica, according to a government statement. No definitive date for the gathering was mentioned.

At the summit, the presidents will discuss the agenda for Clinton's first-ever visit to the region. Clinton will meet with the Central American leaders in San Jose as part of a Latin American tour that will take him through Mexico, Brazil, Argentina and Barbados.

The region's presidents plan to discuss the expulsion of illegal immigrants from the United States, drug trafficking, money laundering and the traffic of stolen automobiles with Clinton, Honduran Foreign Minister Delmer Panting said.
